record.question: Bench mark at the end of days work is called ~
record.explanation: A temporary benchmark is fixed at the close of a day’s levelling so work can resume later from a known reference elevation. It is distinguished from a permanent/GTS datum mark. Reference: https://sist.sathyabama.ac.in/sist_coursematerial/uploads/SCIA1303.pdf; https://learncst.com/bench-mark-definitions/. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
